notes.title: Update - 27.06
notes.notes:
[b]Hallo! The fourth update fell on a summer sale. I hope you have a festive mood and you will like the update.
[/b]
Let's start with small changes / additions and smoothly move on to larger ones:

[list][*]Added additional supported resolution. You can find them in the settings, either in the main menu or in the in-game.
[*]Improved Anna's hair quality. In the shade and in dark places on the hair there will be no dimming. But they will be slightly highlighted.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37385559/abbbf3f063890b8dd5abfb5099b5dcc018465c53.png[/img]
[*]Added the ability to start the new game in the menu by clicking New Game. Also, when choosing Play Game, the game continues from where you started. If you did not save, then the game will start anew.
[*]When you exit to the main menu or from the game, the game is automatically saved.
[*]Improved shadow quality
[*]Changed global lighting. In general, the lighting became lighter and the shadows softer. The volumetric fog intensity is reduced and the gamma is changed from gray to light blue.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37385559/c3ccf7ccbe6eb0c4d084c770f352b1c787fccc24.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37385559/75f21229074af107d7e5509d811c052b272d6e5c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37385559/33d703859e13383edf99db25eb4602049ed06bfc.png[/img]
[*]New achievement added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37385559/d01a76a3db28b56502fcb7782c11a5b88bc7b6e6.jpg[/img]
[*]The most basic thing that has been added is the location with the bunker. Anna and Victoria did not immediately get out of the underground hospital. For some time they had to be in the bunker. So, after passing the game, in the main menu will have the opportunity to get into the bunker. In the bunker you can watch Victoria’s dance or do vulgar business with her. Two animations are available: Behind and Doggy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37385559/b53e1bdc22cef770870c6240fa33f9b4d32efbb1.png[/img]
[/list]

[i]Also worth mentioning, the current update weighs 6GB. But this includes replacing previous game files. For example, I lowered the resolution of non-key textures. Due to this, there will be less memory consumption. But in Steam these files will be re-downloaded. In general, the game began to weigh less, if before that it required almost 10GB. That is now about 8GB. The update itself weighs no more than 2.5GB.[/i]

[b]Viel Glück![/b]

notes.title: Update - 04.06
notes.notes:
[b]Hello! In the third update, which comes out a little more than a month after the release of the game, added or modified:[/b]

[list][*]Added tips about saving to the menu. Also added to save additional variables.

[*]Only a month later, a problem was identified, due to which when changing the camera or changing clothes, the clothes were out of sync with the character, which is why the clothing animation lagged behind the character animation. Now more of these problems will not arise.

[*]Due to the identification of this problem, the boot time was also completely removed when changing the camera, which was supposed to correct the problem with the clothes out of sync at the time of the screen darkening, at which point the character made a jump.

[*]In-game menu added support for mouse sensitivity. The standard numerical value is 15. But the first time you enter the sensitivity slider, it can be 0 (the sensitivity will be 15), if you move it in any direction, it will be automatically saved, like the numerical value of sensitivity, and when you re-enter the game, it will always be at the specified mark.

[*]Two new achievements added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37385559/b0cc6f0ea46ca0f6eb5f1074d150b15e6889da11.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37385559/bbc0d8dd251fd41714aa094971556baec0f4cb88.jpg[/img]

[*]Added Black Cat outfit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37385559/0de5f2025402361f65383a54119f7019e29db2e7.png[/img]

[*]A new sex scene has been added. To do this, you need to get into a UFO. The UFO itself is located in the farm area. You need to find the sign on which the UFO will be depicted, to stand near it for a small amount of time and aliens will appear who will take you to their research.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37385559/7451a8718a3cc4a738a1a8feb538cbc31993598e.png[/img]

[/list]
